en: Black-and-white postcard view of a small rural village in a gently hilly landscape. Farmhouses and village buildings with pitched roofs cluster in the middle ground, surrounded by fields and patches of forest. The vantage point is from a grassy field looking down toward the settlement, with rolling hills and cultivated land extending into the distance. The caption at the bottom left reads "Polenz bei Neustadt i. Sa." indicating the location depicted.
